premises.text: People lose great ideas because files are scattered across desktop, Dropbox, email, and other repositories—another file-sharing tool is not the answer
premises.evidence_span: We don't need 20 more file sharing solutions. We just need one place where all of our ideas are at our fingertips

premises.text: Docurated discovers files across repositories, strips formatting into indexed normalized components (pages/charts/text/images), and returns best pages by content+context relevance that learns with use and NLP without tagging
premises.evidence_span: discover all of your files across any repository, email, desktop, third parties

premises.text: Ideas appear in a visual collage that can mash pages across formats, export to PowerPoint/PDF, share with visual email preview, or save for anywhere access
premises.evidence_span: All of your ideas are in a visual, beautiful collage, each waiting to be used in a different and new way

premises.text: Product is for everyone with a Dropbox account, not only large enterprises spending billions on knowledge management
premises.evidence_span: we don't believe that DocuRated only belongs to large enterprises. We believe that DocuRated belongs to everyone

value.text: Users get one worthy place where their best ideas/content are findable and reusable at their fingertips
value.evidence_span: one place where all of our ideas are at our fingertips

causal_links.evidence_span: Have you ever had a really good idea and then lost it
your best page appears to you in the order of relevance
Each page can be mashed up from any other page, from any other file format
If you have a Dropbox account, DocuRated is yours

notes: Discover/strip/index/relevance-learning/NLP folded as one 'brains' search mechanism (§4.1.7). Mashup/export/share/save folded as one 'beauty' collage package. Customer testimonial treated as evidence, not premises. $9B enterprise spend as market framing. ASR Docurated/DocuRated/Doctorated variants left in spans. Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
